name: Willow Pond
description: A sleepy pond under weeping willows. A good place to learn.

name: Whisper River
description: A slow river through pine woods. Trout and salmon drift here.

name: Moonlit Cove
description: A quiet sea cove where the moon pulls up strange and lovely things.

name: Glowing Cave
description: Mushrooms glow on the walls of an underground lake.

name: Sky Lake
description: A lake high above the clouds. Nobody knows how the fish got there.
